reviews.decision_reason: The assigned job output preserves all input needs and orders them by observed demand_score descending, which supports the required deterministic downstream prioritization basis for the needs list.

The evidence source ranks are inverted relative to the demand-ranked needs: the lowest demand record n06-r08 is rank 1, while the highest demand record n06-r01 is rank 8. That bad handoff materially drives the downstream recommendation toward n06-r07 instead of the higher-demand unsupported n06-r01.

The provenance handoff contains the behaviorally significant reversed ranks, but the semantic-only package does not expose enough implementation detail to distinguish whether this boundary assembled already-normalized bad evidence or created the bad rank ordering itself.
